environment.scope: One laptop and one GPU/driver configuration; no cross-device guarantee

representation.excludes: Object/driver overhead, other scene geometry and total process/GPU memory

grass_resident_abba.conditions: Final grass snapshot;one process/context with two retained worlds;49 near+81 far each;1600x900 output,1120x630 Low raster,1024 shadow;fingerprints off;I/E/E/I then E/I/I/E;60 samples/block;20 untimed warm frames/block;generation/upload excluded
grass_resident_abba.limit: GL elapsed is a command interval including possible CPU supply gaps, not pure GPU busy time;whole samples include substantial glBeginQuery driver/instrumentation waits;not uninstrumented FPS

normal_stream_single_pair.conditions: Same final helper;fingerprints off;both start from compact CPU geometry;expanded path reconstructs old vertices during upload;82 warm frames+1800 travel frames/600 semantic seconds+3 PNG saves;960x540 Standard;no audio/pacing
normal_stream_single_pair.limit: Single sequential pair;wall is slower for instancing despite lower stream/submit counters;remainder not causally localized;no whole-application speedup established

overall_limit: No universal whole-application,FPS,energy,all-day or language-superiority claim;ordinary GHC CPU work,GLSL GPU work and explicit native/OpenGL dependencies remain separate

publication_note.scope: Selected supplemental development evidence for the v0.12.0 application; this data file was not included in that release tag.
publication_note.adaptation: Selected final grass comparisons and their conditions. All selected numerical values are unchanged. Earlier migration and retained-mesh studies are omitted.
publication_note.verification: Imported documentation evidence; GPU timings were not rerun while authoring this research guide.
